newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African Alexkor diamond mine sees shorter life.
newsitem.headline: S.African Alexkor diamond mine sees shorter life.

text.p: The life of state-owned diamond mine Alexkor could be shorter than anticipated and alternative development strategies are being considered, Public Enterprises Minister Stella Sigcau said on Tuesday.
She told a parliamentary media briefing that Alexkor's profits had fallen by between five and six percent over the past two years.
"This is all to do with the fact that here we are dealing with an industry which does face a lot of challenges, one of which is the lifespan of the mine," she said.
"The life of the mine might be shorter (than anticipated)."

Despite its poor profit record, the mine had a strong balance sheet and reserves of up to 100 million rand. This enabled it to sponsor non-core activities such as farming and agriculture in Namaqualand.
A restructuring committee was looking at broader objectives than the privatisation or restructuring of Alexkor, she said.
